title: Music Songs search autoload: pacing, clock and test follow-ups from the RF-152 review
acceptance: While autoload waits for the per-minute budget, the note says it is paced (not "Searching…" with no request in flight), and a Keep loading tap in that wait counts against the same per-minute budget.
The per-minute budget uses a monotonic clock (performance.now()), so a backward wall-clock change cannot pause autoload.

A decision is recorded on server-side protection for the likes limit (a separate autoload limiter, or honouring a 429 Retry-After), since a client budget cannot see other tabs, first pages or manual Load more taps.
The RF-152 autoload tests use fake timers instead of multi-second real waits, so they are fast and cannot flake on a slow runner.
A retry tap after a round stopped on a load error is decided: it counts as one of that round's requests (today) or starts a new round.
